reels.hook_line: Kenapa ya skincare pagi sama malam itu dibedain?
segs: Kenapa ya skincare pagi sama malam itu dibedain?
Aku baru sadar, ternyata kulit kita itu punya kebutuhan yang berbeda di pagi dan malam hari.
Kalau pagi, kan kita bakal pakai make up, kena panas, kena AC, dan aktivitas seharian.
Jadi aku sekarang lebih fokus ke skin prep yang bikin kulit lembab seharian.
Makanya aku selalu pakai Ines Exclusive All Day Moisturizer sebelum mulai aktivitas.
Kulit aku jadi kerasa lebih balance dan nggak gampang rewel walaupun udah aktivitas seharian.
Kalau malam, fokusnya lebih ke recovery.
Aku cari yang bisa bantu hidrasi dan bikin kulit lebih calm sebelum tidur.
Night Gel Mask dari Ines ini aku selalu pakai sebagai step terakhir buat skincare malam.
Teksturnya ringan dan ada sensasi cooling yang bikin nyaman banget sebelum tidur.
Paginya, kulit kerasa lebih fresh dan lebih tenang.
Sekarang aku jadi lebih paham kenapa skincare pagi dan malam itu nggak bisa disamain.
Kalau kamu lagi nyari skincare buat pagi dan malam, kamu bisa coba Ines Exclusive All Day and Night.

reels.caption:
“You look happier.”
Thanks, I finally allowed myself to do the things I was always too scared to try.

For a long time, I kept holding myself back.
“I’ll join this when I feel more ready.”
“I’ll try that when I’m braver.”
“I’ll apply once I’m good enough.”

Without realizing it, that kind of thinking was what kept me stuck and slowly made me miss out on opportunities.

People often say, “It’s never too late to start something.”
Yes, but… some things come with age limits.
And the freedom to take risks doesn’t last forever.

At some point, I realized no one else is going to make my dreams happen for me.
It’s all up to me.
So, I stopped waiting to be “ready” and started showing up.

To start is the hardest part.
Because starting means facing all the fears you’ve tried to avoid: the fear of being judged, of not being enough, of failing in public.

But if you wait until you feel 100% ready, you might wait forever.

Sometimes, the most powerful thing you can do is take that one small step, scared, uncertain, unpolished, but willing.

That’s how progress begins.
That’s how confidence is built.
And that’s how you grow into the person you’ve always wanted to be.

I did and I could.
So can you
